children: may retest a resistance at $4,374 per ounce, driven by a wave c.
A projection analysis on this wave from $4,291 reveals a target of $4,393, its 61.8% level. The current correction may end around the support at $4,330.
A break below $4,315 may trigger a fall toward $4,291. Only a further fall could confirm the resumption of the downtrend from $4,399.
